subject: I was wrong about your relationship
preview_text: We owe you an apology and something only 68-day users get. Open this before it disappears.
body_paragraphs: Here's the thing—I've been tracking your usage, and I realized something that made me feel like an idiot. You've been with us for 68 days, planning dates, keeping the spark alive, and I never properly thanked you. That's on me. So consider this my public apology and a massive thank you for sticking around when most people would have drifted back into dinner-and-a-movie routine.

You're part of an elite group now—the 230+ couples who've used SoulPlan to actually improve their relationship. 92% of you say it made a real difference. But here's the secret: the real magic happens when you dig deeper than just our AI date ideas. There's a feature most users never touch, and it's the one that changes everything.

I'm talking about the Surprise Date Planner. It's designed for couples who've been together long enough to stop thinking about logistics and start focusing on the thrill of not knowing. Your partner plans, you're surprised, and suddenly date night feels like that first spark all over again. It's the ultimate trust exercise, and it's been sitting there waiting for you. This is the kind of insider access I only share with long-term users like you.

So here's your one job today: open SoulPlan, tap on 'Surprise Date Planner,' and let your partner take the reins. Don't peek. Don't plan. Just show up. P.S. I added a secret date idea to your wishlist that only activates after you use the Surprise feature—it's our way of saying thanks for being a legend.
